## Fig5B — source enrichment and decomposition

```{r analyze-Fig5B-source-enrichment}
dir.create(file.path(REPO, "Fig5/output"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Fig. 3B MQ analysis: ARG gene-source enrichment and species decomposition

required_packages <- c("readr", "dplyr", "tidyr", "tibble", "openxlsx")
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop("Missing R packages: ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
})

project_dir <- REPO
s1_path <- file.path(REPO, "shared/data/MQ_genomes.tsv")
s3_path <- file.path(REPO, "shared/data/ARG_annotations.tsv")

out_root <- file.path(REPO, "Fig5/output")
source_dir <- file.path(REPO, "Fig5/output")
stats_dir <- file.path(REPO, "Fig5/output")
dir.create(source_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(stats_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

source_levels <- c("animal", "human", "food", "other")
minimum_total_carriers <- 5L
minimum_focal_source_carriers <- 3L

clean_category <- function(x, fallback) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x) | trimws(x) == ""] <- fallback
  x
}

s1 <- readr::read_tsv(s1_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
s3 <- readr::read_tsv(s3_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot(nrow(s1) == 25596L, nrow(s3) == 3920L)

mq <- s1 %>%
  transmute(
    genome_id,
    source_type = factor(clean_category(source_type, "other"), levels = source_levels),
    genus = clean_category(genus, "Unclassified genus"),
    species = clean_category(species, "Unclassified at species level"),
    species_annotated = species != "Unclassified at species level"
  )

gene_carriers <- s3 %>%
  distinct(genome_id, ARG_gene, ARG_class) %>%
  left_join(
    mq %>% select(genome_id, source_type, genus, species, species_annotated),
    by = "genome_id"
  )

stopifnot(!anyNA(gene_carriers$source_type), !anyNA(gene_carriers$species))

arg_gene_classes <- gene_carriers %>%
  count(ARG_gene, ARG_class, sort = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(ARG_gene) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(ARG_gene, ARG_class)

all_arg_genes <- sort(unique(gene_carriers$ARG_gene))

enrichment_tests <- lapply(all_arg_genes, function(gene) {
  carrier_ids <- unique(gene_carriers$genome_id[gene_carriers$ARG_gene == gene])
  lapply(source_levels, function(src) {
    in_source <- as.character(mq$source_type) == src
    is_carrier <- mq$genome_id %in% carrier_ids
    contingency <- matrix(
      c(
        sum(is_carrier & in_source),
        sum(!is_carrier & in_source),
        sum(is_carrier & !in_source),
        sum(!is_carrier & !in_source)
      ),
      nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE
    )
    test <- stats::fisher.test(contingency)
    tibble(
      ARG_gene = gene,
      source_type = src,
      carrier_genomes_in_source = contingency[1, 1],
      noncarrier_genomes_in_source = contingency[1, 2],
      carrier_genomes_outside_source = contingency[2, 1],
      noncarrier_genomes_outside_source = contingency[2, 2],
      total_carrier_genomes_MQ = length(carrier_ids),
      odds_ratio = unname(test$estimate),
      p_value = test$p.value
    )
  }) %>% bind_rows()
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  left_join(arg_gene_classes, by = "ARG_gene") %>%
  mutate(
    fdr = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    enriched = fdr < 0.05 & odds_ratio > 1 &
      total_carrier_genomes_MQ >= minimum_total_carriers &
      carrier_genomes_in_source >= minimum_focal_source_carriers
  ) %>%
  select(
    ARG_gene, ARG_class, source_type,
    carrier_genomes_in_source, noncarrier_genomes_in_source,
    carrier_genomes_outside_source, noncarrier_genomes_outside_source,
    total_carrier_genomes_MQ, odds_ratio, p_value, fdr, enriched
  )

# Species breadth is defined from all MQ genomes with a species-level assignment.
species_breadth <- mq %>%
  filter(species_annotated) %>%
  distinct(species, source_type) %>%
  count(species, name = "source_count_for_species")

decompose_gene_source <- function(gene, src) {
  carriers <- gene_carriers %>%
    filter(ARG_gene == gene, as.character(source_type) == src) %>%
    distinct(genome_id, species, species_annotated) %>%
    left_join(species_breadth, by = "species")

  source_restricted_n <- sum(
    carriers$species_annotated & carriers$source_count_for_species == 1,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  multi_source_n <- sum(
    carriers$species_annotated & carriers$source_count_for_species >= 2,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  species_unclassified_n <- sum(!carriers$species_annotated)

  category <- case_when(
    source_restricted_n == 0 & multi_source_n == 0 ~ "Species unclassified",
    source_restricted_n > 0 & multi_source_n > 0 ~ "Mixed species contribution",
    source_restricted_n > 0 ~ "Source-restricted species only",
    multi_source_n > 0 ~ "Multi-source species only",
    TRUE ~ "Species unclassified"
  )

  tibble(
    source_restricted_carriers = source_restricted_n,
    multi_source_carriers = multi_source_n,
    species_unclassified_carriers = species_unclassified_n,
    decomposition_category = category
  )
}

enriched_decomposition <- enrichment_tests %>%
  filter(enriched) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    decomposition = list(
      decompose_gene_source(ARG_gene, as.character(source_type))
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  unnest(decomposition)

category_levels <- c(
  "Multi-source species only",
  "Mixed species contribution",
  "Source-restricted species only",
  "Species unclassified"
)

panel_b_summary <- enriched_decomposition %>%
  count(source_type, decomposition_category, name = "gene_source_associations") %>%
  complete(
    source_type = source_levels,
    decomposition_category = category_levels,
    fill = list(gene_source_associations = 0L)
  ) %>%
  group_by(source_type) %>%
  mutate(
    total_enriched_associations = sum(gene_source_associations),
    proportion = if_else(
      total_enriched_associations > 0,
      gene_source_associations / total_enriched_associations,
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    source_type = factor(source_type, levels = source_levels),
    decomposition_category = factor(
      decomposition_category, levels = category_levels
    )
  )

analysis_manifest <- tibble(
  item = c(
    "MQ genomes", "ARG genes tested", "Gene-source tests",
    "BH-significant enriched associations", "Animal enriched associations",
    "Human enriched associations", "Food enriched associations",
    "Other enriched associations", "Minimum total carriers",
    "Minimum focal-source carriers"
  ),
  value = as.character(c(
    nrow(mq), length(all_arg_genes), nrow(enrichment_tests),
    nrow(enriched_decomposition),
    sum(enriched_decomposition$source_type == "animal"),
    sum(enriched_decomposition$source_type == "human"),
    sum(enriched_decomposition$source_type == "food"),
    sum(enriched_decomposition$source_type == "other"),
    minimum_total_carriers, minimum_focal_source_carriers
  ))
)

readr::write_tsv(
  panel_b_summary,
  file.path(source_dir, "Fig3B_MQ_source_decomposition_summary.tsv")
)
openxlsx::write.xlsx(
  panel_b_summary,
  file.path(source_dir, "Fig3B_MQ_source_decomposition_summary.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)
readr::write_tsv(
  enrichment_tests,
  file.path(stats_dir, "Fig3B_MQ_ARG_source_enrichment_all_tests.tsv")
)
readr::write_tsv(
  enriched_decomposition,
  file.path(stats_dir, "Fig3B_MQ_enriched_association_decomposition.tsv")
)
openxlsx::write.xlsx(
  enriched_decomposition,
  file.path(stats_dir, "Fig3B_MQ_enriched_association_decomposition.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)
readr::write_tsv(
  analysis_manifest,
  file.path(stats_dir, "Fig3B_MQ_analysis_manifest.tsv")
)

message("Fig. 3B MQ analysis completed.")
message("Enriched gene-source associations: ", nrow(enriched_decomposition))
message(
  "By source: ",
  paste(
    enriched_decomposition %>% count(source_type) %>%
      transmute(label = paste0(source_type, "=", n)) %>% pull(label),
    collapse = "; "
  )
)
```

## Fig5C/D — within-species source comparisons

```{r analyze-Fig5CD-within-species}
dir.create(file.path(REPO, "Fig5/output"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Fig. 3C MQ analysis: within-species source effect across all eligible species

required_packages <- c("readr", "dplyr", "tidyr", "tibble", "openxlsx")
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop("Missing R packages: ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
})

project_dir <- REPO
s1_path <- file.path(REPO, "shared/data/MQ_genomes.tsv")
s3_path <- file.path(REPO, "shared/data/ARG_annotations.tsv")

out_root <- file.path(REPO, "Fig5/output")
source_dir <- file.path(REPO, "Fig5/output")
stats_dir <- file.path(REPO, "Fig5/output")
dir.create(source_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(stats_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

source_levels <- c("animal", "human", "food", "other")
minimum_per_source <- 5L

clean_category <- function(x, fallback) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x) | trimws(x) == ""] <- fallback
  x
}

s1 <- readr::read_tsv(s1_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
s3 <- readr::read_tsv(s3_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot(nrow(s1) == 25596L, nrow(s3) == 3920L)

arg_positive_ids <- unique(s3$genome_id)
mq <- s1 %>%
  transmute(
    genome_id,
    genus = clean_category(genus, "Unclassified genus"),
    species = clean_category(species, "Unclassified at species level"),
    source_type = factor(clean_category(source_type, "other"), levels = source_levels),
    ARG_positive = genome_id %in% arg_positive_ids
  )

# Species without a species-level assignment remain in global analyses but are
# deliberately excluded here because this panel is explicitly species-stratified.
species_source_counts <- mq %>%
  filter(species != "Unclassified at species level") %>%
  count(genus, species, source_type, ARG_positive, name = "n") %>%
  complete(
    nesting(genus, species, source_type),
    ARG_positive = c(FALSE, TRUE),
    fill = list(n = 0L)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = ARG_positive, values_from = n,
    names_prefix = "ARG_positive_"
  ) %>%
  rename(
    ARG_negative_n = ARG_positive_FALSE,
    ARG_positive_n = ARG_positive_TRUE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    source_n = ARG_negative_n + ARG_positive_n,
    ARG_positive_rate = ARG_positive_n / source_n
  ) %>%
  filter(source_n >= minimum_per_source)

eligible_species <- species_source_counts %>%
  distinct(species, source_type) %>%
  count(species, name = "eligible_source_count") %>%
  filter(eligible_source_count >= 2)

eligible_profiles <- species_source_counts %>%
  semi_join(eligible_species, by = "species") %>%
  arrange(species, source_type)

test_one_species <- function(df) {
  contingency <- as.matrix(df[, c("ARG_positive_n", "ARG_negative_n")])
  test <- stats::fisher.test(contingency, simulate.p.value = FALSE)
  max_rate <- max(df$ARG_positive_rate)
  min_rate <- min(df$ARG_positive_rate)
  highest_sources <- as.character(df$source_type[df$ARG_positive_rate == max_rate])
  lowest_sources <- as.character(df$source_type[df$ARG_positive_rate == min_rate])
  tibble(
    genus = first(df$genus),
    species = first(df$species),
    eligible_source_count = nrow(df),
    total_MQ_genomes = sum(df$source_n),
    total_ARG_positive = sum(df$ARG_positive_n),
    minimum_source_n = min(df$source_n),
    maximum_source_n = max(df$source_n),
    minimum_ARG_positive_rate = min_rate,
    maximum_ARG_positive_rate = max_rate,
    max_rate_difference = max_rate - min_rate,
    highest_rate_source = paste(highest_sources, collapse = "/"),
    lowest_rate_source = paste(lowest_sources, collapse = "/"),
    p_value = test$p.value
  )
}

species_tests <- eligible_profiles %>%
  group_split(species) %>%
  lapply(test_one_species) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    fdr = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    minus_log10_fdr = -log10(pmax(fdr, .Machine$double.xmin)),
    significant = fdr < 0.05
  ) %>%
  arrange(fdr, desc(max_rate_difference))

profile_export <- eligible_profiles %>%
  left_join(
    species_tests %>% select(species, fdr, significant, max_rate_difference),
    by = "species"
  ) %>%
  mutate(source_type = as.character(source_type))

manifest <- tibble(
  item = c(
    "MQ genomes", "Unclassified-at-species MQ genomes",
    "Minimum genomes per retained species-source stratum",
    "Eligible multi-source species", "BH-significant species",
    "Species with highest rate in animal", "Species with highest rate in human",
    "Species with highest rate in food", "Species with highest rate in other"
  ),
  value = as.character(c(
    nrow(mq), sum(mq$species == "Unclassified at species level"),
    minimum_per_source, nrow(species_tests), sum(species_tests$significant),
    sum(species_tests$highest_rate_source == "animal"),
    sum(species_tests$highest_rate_source == "human"),
    sum(species_tests$highest_rate_source == "food"),
    sum(species_tests$highest_rate_source == "other")
  ))
)

readr::write_tsv(
  species_tests,
  file.path(source_dir, "Fig3C_MQ_within_species_source_effect.tsv")
)
openxlsx::write.xlsx(
  species_tests,
  file.path(source_dir, "Fig3C_MQ_within_species_source_effect.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)
readr::write_tsv(
  profile_export,
  file.path(stats_dir, "Fig3C_MQ_species_source_ARG_positive_profiles.tsv")
)
openxlsx::write.xlsx(
  profile_export,
  file.path(stats_dir, "Fig3C_MQ_species_source_ARG_positive_profiles.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)
readr::write_tsv(
  manifest,
  file.path(stats_dir, "Fig3C_MQ_analysis_manifest.tsv")
)

message("Fig. 3C MQ analysis completed.")
message("Eligible multi-source species: ", nrow(species_tests))
message("BH-significant species: ", sum(species_tests$significant))
```

## Fig5D — significant-species heatmap

```{python plot-Fig5D-species-heatmap}
"""Fig. 3D alternative: conventional species-by-source heatmap."""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
import os
REPO = Path(os.environ["FIGURE_REPO_ROOT"])
(REPO / "Fig5/output").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib as mpl
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap
from matplotlib.colors import Normalize
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle


SCRIPT_PATH = (REPO / 'Fig5/Fig5.Rmd')
ROOT = (REPO / 'Fig5/output')
PANEL_C_ROOT = (REPO / 'Fig5/output')
SUMMARY_PATH = (REPO / 'Fig5/data/Fig3C_MQ_within_species_source_effect.tsv')
PROFILE_PATH = (REPO / 'Fig5/data/Fig3C_MQ_species_source_ARG_positive_profiles.tsv')
EXPORT_DIR = (REPO / 'Fig5/output/exports')
SOURCE_DATA_DIR = (REPO / 'Fig5/output')
EXPORT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
SOURCE_DATA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

SOURCE_LEVELS = ["animal", "human", "food", "other"]
SOURCE_LABELS = ["Animal", "Human", "Food", "Other"]
SOURCE_COLORS = {
    "animal": "#B48770",
    "human": "#6F879F",
    "food": "#7BAA8E",
    "other": "#A9AFB6",
}

TEXT_COLOR = "#26323A"
MUTED_TEXT = "#66717B"
AXIS_COLOR = "#59636C"


def pretty_species(name: str) -> str:
    replacements = {
        "Lactobacillus sp910589675": "Lactobacillus sp. 910589675",
        "Lactobacillus sp945980025": "Lactobacillus sp. 945980025",
        "Limosilactobacillus reuteri_I": "Limosilactobacillus reuteri I",
        "Limosilactobacillus reuteri_J": "Limosilactobacillus reuteri J",
    }
    return replacements.get(name, name)


def main() -> None:
    mpl.rcParams.update(
        {
            "font.family": "sans-serif",
            "font.sans-serif": ["Arial", "Helvetica", "DejaVu Sans", "sans-serif"],
            "svg.fonttype": "none",
            "pdf.fonttype": 42,
            "axes.linewidth": 0.55,
            "axes.spines.top": False,
            "axes.spines.right": False,
            "font.size": 7,
        }
    )

    summary = pd.read_csv(SUMMARY_PATH, sep="\t")
    profiles = pd.read_csv(PROFILE_PATH, sep="\t")
    sig = summary.loc[summary["significant"].astype(str).str.upper() == "TRUE"].copy()
    sig["highest_source_group"] = pd.Categorical(
        sig["highest_rate_source"],
        categories=["animal", "human", "other", "food"],
        ordered=True,
    )
    sig = sig.sort_values(
        ["highest_source_group", "max_rate_difference", "minus_log10_fdr"],
        ascending=[True, False, False],
    ).reset_index(drop=True)
    species_order = sig["species"].tolist()

    plot_data = profiles.merge(
        sig[["species", "highest_rate_source", "max_rate_difference", "fdr"]],
        on="species",
        how="inner",
    )
    plot_data["ARG_positive_pct"] = 100 * plot_data["ARG_positive_rate"]
    plot_data["species_pretty"] = plot_data["species"].map(pretty_species)
    plot_data.to_csv(
        (REPO / 'Fig5/output/Fig3D_MQ_within_species_heatmap_source_data.tsv'),
        sep="\t",
        index=False,
    )

    matrix = (
        plot_data.pivot_table(
            index="species",
            columns="source_type",
            values="ARG_positive_pct",
            aggfunc="first",
            observed=False,
        )
        .reindex(index=species_order, columns=SOURCE_LEVELS)
    )
    values = matrix.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    masked = np.ma.masked_invalid(values)

    cmap = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list(
        "arg_rate",
        ["#F4F6F4", "#D9E5DE", "#AFCBBC", "#6E9E86", "#2E6657"],
    )
    cmap.set_bad("#ECEFF1")

    highest_counts = sig["highest_rate_source"].value_counts().reindex(
        SOURCE_LEVELS, fill_value=0
    )
    animal_high = int(highest_counts["animal"])
    total_sig = int(len(sig))

    fig = plt.figure(figsize=(112 / 25.4, 112 / 25.4))
    ax = fig.add_axes([0.42, 0.17, 0.31, 0.68])
    cax = fig.add_axes([0.82, 0.25, 0.020, 0.48])
    side_ax = fig.add_axes([0.745, 0.17, 0.025, 0.68], sharey=ax)

    norm = Normalize(vmin=0, vmax=80)
    n_rows, n_cols = values.shape
    for i in range(n_rows):
        for j in range(n_cols):
            value = values[i, j]
            facecolor = "#ECEFF1" if np.isnan(value) else cmap(norm(value))
            ax.add_patch(
                Rectangle(
                    (j - 0.5, i - 0.5),
                    1,
                    1,
                    facecolor=facecolor,
                    edgecolor="white",
                    linewidth=0.35,
                )
            )
    ax.set_xlim(-0.5, len(SOURCE_LEVELS) - 0.5)
    ax.set_ylim(len(species_order) - 0.5, -0.5)

    ax.set_xticks(np.arange(len(SOURCE_LEVELS)))
    ax.set_xticklabels(SOURCE_LABELS, rotation=0, color=TEXT_COLOR)
    ax.set_yticks(np.arange(len(species_order)))
    ax.set_yticklabels([pretty_species(s) for s in species_order], fontstyle="italic", color=TEXT_COLOR)
    ax.tick_params(axis="both", length=0, labelsize=5.8)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_visible(False)

    side_ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
    side_ax.set_xticks([])
    side_ax.set_yticks(np.arange(len(species_order)))
    side_ax.tick_params(left=False, labelleft=False)
    for i, species in enumerate(species_order):
        source = str(sig.loc[sig["species"] == species, "highest_rate_source"].iloc[0])
        side_ax.scatter(
            0.5,
            i,
            s=24,
            facecolor=SOURCE_COLORS.get(source, "#D2D7DC"),
            edgecolor="white",
            linewidth=0.5,
        )
    for spine in side_ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_visible(False)
    side_ax.set_ylim(ax.get_ylim())
    side_ax.set_title("Highest", fontsize=5.6, color=MUTED_TEXT, pad=5)

    for y0 in np.linspace(0, 80, 80, endpoint=False):
        cax.add_patch(
            Rectangle(
                (0, y0),
                1,
                1.02,
                facecolor=cmap(norm(y0 + 0.5)),
                edgecolor="none",
                linewidth=0,
            )
        )
    cax.set_xlim(0, 1)
    cax.set_ylim(0, 80)
    cax.set_xticks([])
    cax.set_yticks([0, 20, 40, 60, 80])
    cax.yaxis.tick_right()
    cax.yaxis.set_label_position("right")
    cax.set_ylabel("ARG-positive genomes (%)", fontsize=5.8, color=TEXT_COLOR)
    cax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=5.3, colors=TEXT_COLOR, length=2)
    for spine in cax.spines.values():
        spine.set_linewidth(0.4)
        spine.set_edgecolor(AXIS_COLOR)

    handles = [
        plt.Line2D(
            [0],
            [0],
            marker="o",
            color="none",
            markerfacecolor=SOURCE_COLORS[source],
            markeredgecolor="white",
            markersize=5.0,
            label=label,
        )
        for source, label in zip(SOURCE_LEVELS, SOURCE_LABELS)
    ]
    fig.legend(
        handles=handles,
        loc="lower left",
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.40, 0.06),
        frameon=False,
        ncol=4,
        handletextpad=0.25,
        columnspacing=0.7,
        fontsize=5.5,
    )

    fig.text(0.035, 0.955, "d", fontsize=9.5, fontweight="bold", ha="left", va="top", color=TEXT_COLOR)
    fig.text(
        0.42,
        0.94,
        "Within-species ARG carriage by source",
        fontsize=7.8,
        fontweight="bold",
        ha="left",
        va="top",
        color=TEXT_COLOR,
    )
    fig.text(
        0.42,
        0.895,
        f"{animal_high}/{total_sig} significant species were animal-high",
        fontsize=6.0,
        ha="left",
        va="top",
        color=MUTED_TEXT,
    )

    stem = (REPO / 'Fig5/output/Fig3D_MQ_within_species_source_heatmap')
    fig.savefig(stem.with_suffix(".svg"), transparent=False)
    try:
        fig.savefig(stem.with_suffix(".pdf"), transparent=False)
    except PermissionError as exc:
        print(f"Skipped PDF export because the file is locked: {exc}")
    fig.savefig(stem.with_suffix(".png"), dpi=450, transparent=False)
    fig.savefig(
        stem.with_suffix(".tiff"),
        dpi=600,
        transparent=False,
        pil_kwargs={"compression": "tiff_lzw"},
    )
    plt.close(fig)

    print(f"Exported Fig. 3D heatmap to: {EXPORT_DIR}")


main()
```
